textmask.onnx — text-mask segmenter for comic text crops (comic-text-mask).

Source: https://huggingface.co/TareHimself/comic-text-mask (model.safetensors,
config.json, tm_meta.json at revision ebd37f1a9ae9298519678fb96a796573fb602977),
by TareHimself, made with segmentation-models-pytorch (a U-Net on a ResNet-18).
Modified for Gytakusub: rebuilt as an ONNX graph from the safetensors weights,
batch normalisation folded into the convolutions, ImageNet normalisation and the
sigmoid included, weights stored as float16 (computed in float32), by
scripts/textmask-onnx.py; see textmask.json for the source, checksums and settings.

revision. The repository has no licence file of its own and the model card names
no copyright holder; the notice below names the author and the year the
